name: solid
prompt: Create a production monochrome UI icon variant from the attached approved AgentMeter Watchful Agent icon. Preserve the core recognizable geometry: a mouthless rounded rectangular robot face with two vertical capsule eye holes, and above it a thick gauge arc with one short separated segment at upper right. Square canvas, centered optical balance, total symbol occupies 78 percent of width and height, generous equal transparent margins. Strictly ONE FLAT INK COLOR on actual alpha transparency; all negative spaces and eye holes are transparent. No gray shading, gradients, texture, shadow, glow, bevel, 3D, background panel unless specifically requested, no text, no explanatory labels. Exceptionally clean antialiased geometry, large generous eyes and gap in gauge for UI legibility. Keep facial proportions and arc relationship true to reference, do not turn into headphones, no ears, no antenna. SOLID variant: remove the original enclosing app tile entirely. A solid filled rounded robot face silhouette, its two eye holes punched out as transparent slots. Above it, the gauge is two thick solid round-ended arc segments separated by one clear gap at upper-right. Face and arc remain separate, nothing connects them. Use exclusively pure BLACK #000000 ink.
